rules.text: a template matches only against SUPPLIED root radicals filling R1..R3 in order; no root is derived here

a matched row names the TEMPLATE and the template's home class; it does not settle class membership where the row is declared shared, because that decision is semantic (stable attribute vs reported action) and is not readable off letters
the feminine of a row is a declared template, never a suffixation: the فعلان row takes the فعلى shape and the أفعل row takes the فعلاء shape
restricted (diptote) inflection is a property carried by the row and is emitted as a flag only; the definiteness and annexation conditions that relax it are NOT decided here
where two rows are letter-identical the pack declares both, so the skeleton abstains ambiguous_template — the vowel-only disposition/short split and the colour/elative split are both pinned this way
the أفعل skeleton is routed to the elative discriminator unit; this unit never resolves it
